scoring_formula.description: Per certificate, add finding weights and cap at 10. Health Score = 100 - (Capped Risk Points / (Certificate Count * 10)) * 100

prioritized_findings.title: RSA key is too small
prioritized_findings.description: RSA keys smaller than 2048 bits do not meet this scanner's policy.
prioritized_findings.recommendation: Replace the certificate with an RSA key of at least 2048 bits or an approved alternative.

prioritized_findings.title: Weak signature hash algorithm
prioritized_findings.description: SHA-1 and MD5 are not accepted by this scanner's security policy.
prioritized_findings.recommendation: Reissue the certificate using SHA-256 or a stronger approved hash.

prioritized_findings.title: Subject and issuer are identical
prioritized_findings.description: The certificate is self-issued based on matching subject and issuer names. This alone does not prove its signature is self-signed.
prioritized_findings.recommendation: Verify whether this certificate is explicitly trusted and whether a CA-issued certificate is required.
